title: auricula lutea
intro: Auricula lutea, commonly known as Bear's Foot or Golden Bear's Foot, is a perennial herb belonging to the Saxifragaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and support respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Auricula lutea are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which can help to ease coughs, colds, and other respiratory ailments. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
